versions.subject: Initial batch of ESXi content
versions.detection: `esxi_syslog` Message IN ("*has powered on*","*is powered off*") | rex field=_raw "Event \d+ : (?<vm>\S+)(?: on (?<location>\S+))?(?: in (?<datacenter>\S+))?" | eval event_time = _time | eval event_type = case( match(_raw, "powered on"), "power_on", match(_raw, "powered off"), "power_off" ) | stats latest(eval(if(event_type=="power_on", event_time, null()))) as LastPowerOnTime, latest(eval(if(event_type=="power_off", event_time, null()))) as LastPowerOffTime, values(location) as location, values(datacenter) as datacenter, values(host) as host by vm | where isnotnull(LastPowerOffTime) AND isnotnull(LastPowerOnTime) | where LastPowerOnTime - LastPowerOffTime > 2592000 | eval LastPowerOffTime = strftime(LastPowerOffTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval LastPowerOnTime = strftime(LastPowerOnTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime count by vm location datacenter host LastPowerOffTime LastPowerOnTime | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | `esxi_dormant_vm_started_filter`
versions.spl: sourcetype=vmw-syslog OR sourcetype=vmware:esxlog* Message IN ("*has powered on*","*is powered off*") | rex field=_raw "Event \d+ : (?<vm>\S+)(?: on (?<location>\S+))?(?: in (?<datacenter>\S+))?" | eval event_time = _time | eval event_type = case( match(_raw, "powered on"), "power_on", match(_raw, "powered off"), "power_off" ) | stats latest(eval(if(event_type=="power_on", event_time, null()))) as LastPowerOnTime, latest(eval(if(event_type=="power_off", event_time, null()))) as LastPowerOffTime, values(location) as location, values(datacenter) as datacenter, values(host) as host by vm | where isnotnull(LastPowerOffTime) AND isnotnull(LastPowerOnTime) | where LastPowerOnTime - LastPowerOffTime > 2592000 | eval LastPowerOffTime = strftime(LastPowerOffTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval LastPowerOnTime = strftime(LastPowerOnTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime count by vm location datacenter host LastPowerOffTime LastPowerOnTime | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" ctime(firstTime) | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" ctime(lastTime) | MACRO=esxi_dormant_vm_started_filter
